INSTRUCTIONS: Copy this file, rename it, tune parameters.
Reference in a run file as: trackers/TOMHT/my_TOMHT
This file contains TOMHT-SPECIFIC algorithm tuning only.
Shared environment params (volume, beta, Pd, filter) live in:

PARAM_DOCS.tracker_type: GNN | JPDA | TOMHT — which tracking algorithm to use.
PARAM_DOCS.filter_model: CV = straight line assumption. IMM = handles turns (recommended).
PARAM_DOCS.far_mht: False alarm rate for TOMHT. 1e-6 typical.
PARAM_DOCS.tomht_threshold_multiplier: [coarse med fine] x gate. 3-level hypothesis pruning.
PARAM_DOCS.max_branches: Max hypotheses per track. 3-8 typical. More=slower but more thorough.
PARAM_DOCS.confirm_threshold: Score to confirm a track. 5-20 typical.
PARAM_DOCS.delete_threshold: Score below which track is deleted. -3 to -10 typical.
